'''Venra root''' was an [[Foodstuff/Legends|edible]] [[Plant/Legends|root]]. The root could be carried by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]]s of the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. A few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|defeat]] on Endor<ref name="Heroes" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Ewok shaman [[Keoulkeech]] as well as another Ewok [[Unidentified Ewok shaman|shaman]] carried a venra root with them.<ref name="Heroes" />

==Behind the scenes==
Venra root was mentioned in ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', a [[1995]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook written by [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] and [[Paul Sudlow]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Heroes" />
